# security

nullspace protects other players' archives, so security here covers protection bypasses as well as crashes.

## what to report privately

- a way to enter, build in, open containers in or take items from an archive without the permission it should need, including through other mods or carry on.
- duplicating or deleting items, chunks or archives, corrupting saved archive data, or crashing or hanging a server from a client.
- anything that shows a player another player's position or private data against the owner's settings.
- a malformed or abusable packet or command.

ordinary bugs, crashes on your own machine and feature ideas go in a normal issue.

## how to report

use github's private reporting: the security tab, then "report a vulnerability" ([report one here](https://github.com/cinderworks-mc/nullspace/security/advisories/new)). please don't open a public issue or post details in chat.

include the minecraft, neoforge, tempad and nullspace versions, the other mods you run, numbered steps, and the log if you have one. take your player name, ip address and the user name in file paths out of it first.

if that page isn't available to you, open a plain issue that only says you have a security report and want to be contacted. the details can move somewhere private from there.

## what to expect

this is a one person hobby project. a first reply usually comes within a week, and fixes for confirmed protection bypasses go in before new features. please give it a fair amount of time before you publish a problem.

## supported versions

only the newest release for minecraft 1.21.
